# cloudminator_ssh_key (Resource)

An SSH public key on the organization's key ring. Keys are immutable; any change replaces the key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudminator_ssh_key" "laptop" {
  name       = "laptop"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `public_key` (String) OpenSSH public key line, e.g. `ssh-ed25519 AAAA… user@host`.

### Optional

- `org` (String) Organization slug. Defaults to the provider's `org`. Changing it forces a new resource.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `fingerprint` (String) SHA256 fingerprint (OpenSSH format).
- `id` (String) Server-assigned key id.
- `key_type` (String) Key algorithm, e.g. `ssh-ed25519`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import an SSH key by organization and key id.
terraform import cloudminator_ssh_key.laptop acme/sshkey-0123456789abcdef01234567
```
